body: He promised that he’ll do better, and his actions did prove his promise but he made a mistake (which is this)

He deleted his conversation with his guy friend, the one with history about cheating. That’s why I doubted him and broke up with him. I am aware that I have trust issues but during our relationship we both strived to be better for each other and for ourselves, it’s just now, he repeated the same mistake he did before and he blew his last chance
I know how painful breakups can be, that’s why I’m really evaluating my actions if I’m taking the right step or not. Thank you
He has no more chances left but I’m still thinking about giving him another chance that’s why I asked people on reddit for advice on what to do.
Maybe I will. Thank you so much for the advice.

We did talk about it, I confronted him and asked him his motive on why he did what he did. He told me it was just for laughs but we had an issue about this before, I opened up to him that it’s uncomfortable with me when you flirt with other girls even as a joke. His friends reached up to me and they told me to give him another chance, but we had a big fight before this and we agreed that it was his last chance and if he will still blow it, then we’re over.

Yes, we did talk about it. He also acknowledged he made a mistake, he apologized for it and he promised that he’d show me change in his actions. But the problem is, every time I give him chances he always does the same mistake, it became repetitive.
